tickets.title: Wi-Fi keeps disconnecting in Library Block B
tickets.description: Connection drops every 5-10 minutes on the second floor of Library Block B. Affects all devices on the student SSID.

comments.body: Checking the access point logs now, will update in 30 minutes.

tickets.title: Projector in CS-204 not displaying HDMI input
tickets.description: The projector powers on but shows 'no signal' for both HDMI ports. Practical session scheduled tomorrow morning.

tickets.description: Password reset email never arrives and the account is locked after three attempts. Fee payment is pending.

comments.body: Account unlocked, reset link sent to the alternate email on file.

tickets.title: Lab PC-17 restarts randomly during practicals
tickets.description: Machine reboots without warning roughly every 20 minutes. Suspected power supply or thermal issue.

comments.body: Campus license renewed and reactivated on all 30 machines.

tickets.title: Printer on 2nd floor jams every print job
tickets.description: Paper feeds at an angle and jams. Three students reported the same issue this week.

tickets.title: Slow internet in Hostel C rooms
tickets.description: Speeds under 1 Mbps in the evening. Online classes are impossible from the room.

tickets.title: Smart classroom mic not working
tickets.description: Ceiling microphone is not picked up by the lecture capture system. Guest lecture scheduled today.

tickets.title: Need SPSS installed for statistics lab
tickets.description: SPSS is required for the third-year statistics practical batch starting next month.

tickets.title: Forgot ERP password, reset link not arriving
tickets.description: Reset email is not delivered to the registered address, possibly filtered by the college spam gateway.

tickets.title: Wi-Fi authentication fails for new faculty accounts
tickets.description: Faculty joining this semester get an 'authentication failed' error on the staff SSID. At least six people affected.

tickets.description: Flatbed scanner returns blank sheets while the preview looks correct. Needed for question paper digitisation.

tickets.description: Remote has been missing since the workshop last Friday. Projector works only from the wall switch.

tickets.title: Desktop in reception will not boot
tickets.description: Machine shows a blinking cursor after POST. Visitor registration desk is unusable.

tickets.description: Repeated disconnections during the proctored exam window. Thirty students were affected mid-test.

tickets.title: Guest Wi-Fi access for campus visit
tickets.description: Temporary guest credentials needed for 25 delegates attending the industry visit.

tickets.title: Lab headphones not detected on 4 machines

tickets.title: Turnitin similarity report not generating
tickets.description: Reports stay in 'pending' state for more than a day for all submissions this week.

tickets.title: CCTV monitoring PC needs antivirus update

tickets.title: Projector bulb flickering in EC-102
